_comment: T134 — the third-party services this estate integrates with.
🔴 NOTHING DECLARED THESE before 2026-08-13. They appeared only incidentally in skills.json,
hygiene-policy.json and mcp-exposure-baseline.json, so a catalog derived from the other
registries (tools-policy, stacks-policy, sdlc.json -> mcp, deps-policy, /health,
social_integrations) rendered host CLIs and SDKs while omitting every third-party API —
and looked complete doing it. That is the failure mode this whole surface exists to prevent.
credentials       the env keys the service needs, MEASURED against infisical dev on
2026-08-13, not guessed. ⚠️ The first draft of this file invented 11 names
and SIX WERE WRONG — AWS in particular uses AWS_ACCESS_KEY /
AWS_ACCESS_SECRET, NOT the AWS-standard AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID /
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. A wrong key here makes a service read
'credential missing' forever, i.e. confidently wrong about the one thing
this file exists to report. Re-measure before adding an entry.
VALUES ARE NEVER READ — only presence and digests (see the change's
requirement 4).
expected_absent   true = the credentials were verified ABSENT from infisical dev at authoring
time. This is a CLAIM, and it is what separates 'we know it is not there'
from 'nobody checked'. Without it those two render identically.
probe             'http' = a URL that answers without auth. 'none' = liveness is not
observable from here, which renders as `unknown`, NEVER as down.
🔗 T95 owns the human-readable half — the connector map and the per-service data-flow .mmd.
This is the machine-readable half. The two must agree, and a service in one but not the
other is drift worth reporting.
oauth_providers  the per-member account links, declared 2026-08-14 (T134 Phase 2). There was NO
provider vocabulary anywhere before this: `social_integrations.provider` is free
text with one live value (`linkedin`), and `provider_type_enum` is
person|organization — the ENTITY type, not the provider. So the connections page
had nothing to enumerate and hardcoded LinkedIn.
implemented    false = declared, NOT built. It renders disabled with its note rather than a
Connect button that cannot work. T94(b) owns building the connectors.

services.title: Stripe
services.note: 🔴 No STRIPE_* key exists in infisical dev, yet the stripe-checkout and stripe-webhook edge functions are DEPLOYED and ACTIVE. Either they are configured through another store, or they cannot work. The catalog should render this as declared ✅ / configured ❌ — which is true and is the point.

services.title: Hume EVI
services.note: VITE_HUME_API_KEY also exists — a client-exposed duplicate of HUME_API_KEY. Worth a look: a VITE_-prefixed key is bundled into the browser by design.

services.title: Google Analytics 4
services.note: No GA4 key in infisical dev. The key name here is the expected shape, not a measured one — confirm before treating a 'missing' verdict as real.

services.title: Calendly
services.note: No Calendly key in infisical dev. Same caveat as ga4 — expected shape, not measured.

services.title: AWS
services.note: ⚠️ NON-STANDARD key names — AWS_ACCESS_KEY / AWS_ACCESS_SECRET, not the AWS SDK's AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Measured 2026-08-13. Anything reading these via a default AWS credential provider will not find them.

services.title: Crypto Payouts
services.note: T95 — added 2026-09-16. No external credential exists because no real chain settlement exists yet: process-payout's 'approve' action generates a mocked tx hash, never calling out to any blockchain. Its only auth is an exact-match check against SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY — a platform-wide secret, not one minted for this connector, but still the credential its auth model depends on.

evidence.method: OAuth 2.0 authorization_code + refresh_token via LinkedIn REST API v2; migrated to unified connector framework (T442, AgDR-0034). No official remote MCP server.

scopes.description: Verify your LinkedIn OpenID identity
Read your basic LinkedIn profile (name, headline, avatar)
Read your primary LinkedIn email address
Publish and manage posts on your personal LinkedIn feed
Publish and manage posts on LinkedIn Company Pages you administer

oauth_providers.title: GitHub

evidence.method: GitHub App user-to-server OAuth + installation token refresh (GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID / GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_SECRET); supports unattended background refresh and fine-grained repository, PR, and activity permissions (T442, AgDR-0034).

scopes.description: Read your GitHub profile and account metadata
Read repository metadata and commit statuses granted to the GitHub App
Read pull requests, reviews, and merge status
Read contribution and repository activity events

oauth_providers.note: GitHub App service connection (/api/connections/github/{start,callback}) → public.connections; distinct from Supabase GitHub sign-in identity (T442).

oauth_providers.title: Upwork

evidence.method: Measured in T537 (upwork_mcp_spike.py, 2026-10-02..2026-10-05): Upwork OAuth 2.1 DCR (https://mcp.upwork.com/register) rejected non-localhost https:// redirect URIs with HTTP 400 invalid_redirect_uri; legacy GraphQL API is deprecated; server-side storage awaits Upwork support ToS sign-off (AgDR-0034).

scopes.description: Read Upwork contracts, milestones, and work diary summaries via MCP
Read submitted Upwork proposals and cover letters via MCP
Read Upwork message rooms and thread history via MCP
Search and read Upwork job postings via MCP

oauth_providers.note: T537 / T442 — Adapter and MCP allowlist built; remote web OAuth connect is on hold because Upwork DCR rejects non-localhost https:// callbacks (HTTP 400 invalid_redirect_uri) and server-side storage awaits Upwork support ToS sign-off. Local MCP sync runs via upwork_mcp_sync.py.

oauth_providers.title: Credly

evidence.method: Measured in T94 (docs/backend/CONNECTOR-RESEARCH-MATRIX.md): REST badge API only, no official MCP.

scopes.description: Read issued Credly badges and certification metadata

oauth_providers.note: T94(b) — declared, NOT implemented. No connector, no credentials declared.

oauth_providers.title: Reddit

evidence.method: Measured in T94 (docs/backend/CONNECTOR-RESEARCH-MATRIX.md): OAuth2 authorization_code with duration=permanent refresh token (1h access token); no official MCP.

scopes.description: Read Reddit username and account karma
Read posts and comments in subscribed subreddits
Read user submission and comment history

oauth_providers.note: T94(b) — declared, NOT implemented. HIGH PRIORITY per owner ask 2026-09-16 (see project/tickets/T94.md Status notes). OAuth2 authorization_code, 1h access tokens, refreshable; rung 2 (read sync) on the depth ladder, no webhook, no official MCP. New Data API apps must register with Reddit by 2026-09-30 — sequence the adapter build accordingly.

oauth_providers.title: Meta Threads

evidence.method: Meta Threads API v1.0 (https://graph.threads.net/v1.0/keyword_search) with per-member OAuth 2.0 / 60-day long-lived user access tokens stored encrypted in public.connections (T550, T575, AgDR-0034).

scopes.description: Read your Threads profile (id, username, display name, avatar)
Search public Threads hiring posts by keyword (up to 2,200 queries / 24h per user)
Read replies and hiring thread conversations
Publish and manage replies on hiring threads

oauth_providers.note: Connected via unified /api/connections/threads/{start,callback} OAuth flow or member access token in /me/connectors → public.connections (T575).
